## Pixo Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026. Thanks for using Pixo — this policy explains, in plain language, how the app handles your data.

### 1. We Do Not Collect Any Information
Pixo runs entirely on your device. **We do not collect, upload or share any user information.** There is no account system, no analytics, no ad SDK. All artwork and user data come from Pixiv official public APIs and are displayed only on your device.

### 2. Permissions
Every permission Pixo requests serves one purpose — saving artwork to your device:

- **Storage permission**: used only to save downloaded illustrations and novels to your chosen folder.
- **All files access**: used only to read/write the download folder you manually picked. It never scans or reads other files.
- **Network**: used only to reach Pixiv official services.

> [!NOTE]
> The app never reads your contacts, messages, photo library or location.

### 3. Login Credentials
- Your token and session cookie are **stored only on this device**.
- They are used solely to request the Pixiv API and never sent to any third-party server.
- You will need to sign in again on a new device; the app does not sync credentials.

### 4. Network Access
The app only connects to Pixiv official services:

- `app-api.pixiv.net` (app API)
- `www.pixiv.net` (web API)
- `i.pximg.net` (image CDN)

### 5. Third-Party Links
External sites opened via "Open in browser" are governed by their own policies and are not our responsibility.

### 6. Data Retention and Deletion
Uninstalling the app removes all locally stored data (credentials, download records, settings). Files already saved to your storage folder are your own and must be deleted by you.

### 7. Policy Updates
If this policy changes, we will update this page and mention it in release notes. Questions? Reach us via the [Issues](https://github.com/Rune-cn/Pixo/issues) page.
